name: Eyes Blueberry Orchard
description: In Taylorsville, KY, Eyes Blueberry Orchard grows Blueberries on a small orchard. The harvest is typically at its peak in summer. The season runs through summer. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Jun – Aug in this growing zone.
Contact the farm directly to confirm current hours and what is ready to pick.
